env.build: origin/main e780fe9 as a git archive snapshot ($SCR/tree) + this change's files copied in: src/dsl/{answer,chapterAnswer,chunkAnswer,index}.ts, src/dsl/parse/{chapter,place}.ts, src/dsl/prompts/{chapter,chapterCompact}.ts, src/harness/types.ts, src/harness/builtins/worldContext.ts, src/renderer/app/land/{chapters,names,witness}.ts, src/renderer/narrative/{chapter,place,route,witness}.ts, tests/dsl/chapterAnswer.test.ts. No Swift changed; the afm-bridge was built from the snapshot's own sources (node scripts/build-afm-bridge.mjs debug, 13.7 s) because bunx electron-vite dev does not build it and a git archive has no .build. node_modules and .env symlinked; the renderer's Vite cacheDir private and its port fixed to 5211 — both only in the snapshot's electron.vite.config.ts
env.launch: mkdir -p $SCR/<ud>; (cd $SCR/tree && AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/<ud> bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9340)   # ud-apple3 for steps 01-05, ud-openai for step 11; each app closed with {cdp: {method: Browser.close}} before the next
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9340 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-chapter-apple/<step file>)" from the repo root (shot paths are repo-relative)
env.ui: zh-TW (system default) in both apps, so the worlds are Traditional Chinese
env.platform: macOS 27.0, Apple Silicon, 16 GB, Apple Intelligence on (no fm serve), Bun 1.3.6, Electron 44.3.0. Another agent's llama-server (8080) and app (9345) ran throughout; nothing here touched them

model.apple: apple-fm system through the in-app afm-bridge (Settings → Model → 這台電腦 → Apple 裝置端), context 4096 (source: model): the guided route for the witness and the chapter
model.openai: openai gpt-5.4-mini, key from the repo .env (the default a fresh userData gets); no context window, so the full prompts
